rows.sql: select ct.pc_0010_id as id, ct.name, ct.email, ct.email__all, ct.phone, ct.phone__all, ct.job_title, ct.lifecycle_stage__label as lifecycle_stage_label, ct.owner__label as owner_name, ct.created_at from contacts ct where :s is null or ct.name ilike '%' || :s || '%' or ct.email ilike '%' || :s || '%' or ct.phone ilike '%' || :s || '%' order by ct.created_at desc limit :limit

total.sql: select count(*) as n from contacts ct where :s is null or ct.name ilike '%' || :s || '%' or ct.email ilike '%' || :s || '%' or ct.phone ilike '%' || :s || '%'

record.sql: select ct.pc_0010_id as id, ct.name, ct.first_name, ct.last_name, ct.email, ct.email__all, ct.phone, ct.phone__all, ct.job_title, ct.lifecycle_stage, ct.owner from contacts ct where ct.pc_0010_id = :id

options: select property, api_value as value, label from property_options where object_type_id = 'pc_0010' and property in ('lifecycle_stage') and record_status = 'active' order by property, display_order
owners: select pc_0000_id as id, name from users where status = 'active' order by name
